title: Cheap n flimsy
text: Cheap n flimsy. Cheap and flimsy. Don’t make my mistake there are much better tables available for $10 more. Wish that’s what I had done

product_metadata.title: Topeakmart C Shaped End Table Couch Table Slim Sofa Side Table Snack Table Coffee Tray for Living Room Small Space Furniture, Dark Brown Wood Top, Slides Up to Sofa/Chair/Recliner
features: 【Stable C table】: The piece features a C-shaped sturdy iron structure and P2 MDF tabletop. Foot pads add more stability and meanwhile protect your floor from scratches. The construction is capable of up to 13.2lb.

【Space-saving tea table】: Enjoy your laptop/tablet time sipping a cup of coffee placed on top. With extra storage on below shelf, you can put and have an easy access to your books/documents/papers on below shelf.
【Versatile】: With this C table, and you’ll have a comfortable time huddling in your sofa. Keep it in your living room give you much convenience.

【Multipurpose furniture piece】: Stylish look and classic C structure allow the item to serve home/commercial purposes. You can use it as a living room sofa side table, extra kitchen dining table, snack table or an office accent table.
【Easy-to-clean snack table】: Treated with metal/wooden finishes, they can be conveniently cleaned with dry/wet soft cloth. No more worries about accidental liquid spills as well.
